capabilities.title: Brand & Visual Communication
capabilities.core: Core: multi-market brand mindshare and end-to-end delivery.
items: Brand Visual Identity (VI): 0→1 brand system development, leading global marketing assets across Singapore, US, Europe, and Japan. Build and manage product 3D libraries with C4D to ensure consistency.
Photography & Post-production: product shooting (scriptwriting) and video production (PR/AE/Jianying). Use motion storytelling to elevate perceived tech value for B2B and B2C products.
Online ops & offline campaigns: social media ads / Google Ads, app banners, ordering screens, and digital posters.

Exhibition design: experience in domestic and large international shows (Asia FLA/FHA, NAMA Show, NRA Show, Smart Retail Tech Expo 2025 ExCeL London), covering planning → layout/print → booth visuals.

capabilities.title: UI/UX & Digital Product Design
capabilities.core: Core: component-based architecture and cross-platform experience.
items: Design system: led Figma-based Design System (component library), standardized UI architecture for multi-brand collaboration, improving delivery efficiency.
Interaction & UX: end-to-end interaction design for smart terminals (vending/auto-cooking machines) and mobile apps, optimizing ordering flows.
Cross-platform adaptation: responsive design for Web, iOS, Android, and touch terminals to keep visual consistency across hardware and mobile devices.

capabilities.title: Growth & Marketing Intelligence
capabilities.core: Core: SEM optimization and media strategy.
items: SEM: Google Ads (PMax / Search) setup and optimization; use cost/ROI monitoring to drive Landing Page optimization and maximize B2B acquisition efficiency.
Data-driven insights: use AI tools to analyze user journeys, translate growth goals into executable visual solutions.

capabilities.title: AI-Driven & Tech
capabilities.core: Core: workflow evolution, frontend understanding, and cost efficiency.
items: AIGC workflow: integrate GPT / Midjourney / Claude Code / Doubao / Gemini to enhance ideation, visuals, copywriting, and design iteration.
Automation engineering: build automated reporting (e.g., Google Ads → Lark bot + AI analysis) with Claude Code / Python / GitHub.
Tech collaboration: work as PM+Designer to collaborate with engineering teams; can implement frontend pages in VS Code to reduce communication cost and deliver clean UI/UX.

capabilities.title: 品牌视觉与多媒体叙事 (Brand & Visual Communication)
capabilities.core: 核心点：多个国家品牌心智、全案落地。
items: 品牌视觉体系 (VI)：具备 0-1 的品牌视觉开发能力，熟练使用（AI/PS）主导过覆盖新加坡、美国、欧洲、日本等市场的品牌形象建设，应用 C4D 建立管理产品库，确保全球化营销物料的统一。
摄影与后期剪辑：具备产品拍摄（撰写脚本）与视频制作能力（PR/AE/剪映），擅长通过动态影像叙事提升 B2B 和 B2C 产品的科技感与溢价力。
线上运营线下活动：不限于社交媒体广告/Google 广告、App Banner/点餐屏幕等电子广告海报设计。
展会设计：拥有国内展会和大型国际展会（亚洲 FLA）（亚洲 FHA）（美国 NAMA Show）（美国 NRA Show）（Smart Retail Tech Expo 2025 ExCeL London）策划参与设计经验，涵盖从内容策划到排版印刷到展位视觉的闭环落地。

capabilities.title: UI/UX 与数字化产品设计 (Core Product Design)
capabilities.core: 核心点：组件化架构、跨端体验。
items: UI/UX 体系构建：主导搭建基于（Figma）的 Design System（组件库），建立标准化的 UI 组件架构（多品牌协同），提升跨部门研发交付效率。
交互逻辑与用户体验：专注于智能终端（自动售餐机/炒菜机）与移动端 App 的全链路交互设计，优化用户下单路径。
跨端适配力：适配 Web、iOS、Android 及触控终端的响应式设计，确保产品在物理硬件与移动设备间的视觉一致性。

capabilities.title: 增长营销与数据驱动 (Growth & Marketing Intelligence)
capabilities.core: 核心点：SEM 优化、投放策略。
items: SEM 营销：Google Ads（PMax）（Search）投放与优化，通过数据监测（成本/回报）倒推 Landing Page 优化策略，实现 B2B 获客效率最大化。
数据分析洞察：运用 AI 工具分析用户行为路径，以业务增长为终极目标，将营销目标拆解为可落地的视觉方案。

capabilities.title: AI 协同与自动化开发 (AI-Driven & Tech)
capabilities.core: 核心点：工作流进化、前端理解、降本增效。
items: AIGC 工作流集成：集成 GPT/Midjourney/Claude Code/豆包/Gemini 提升创意产出上限，将 AI 辅助出图、文案生成与设计重绘无缝融入日常工作流。
自动化工程能力：利用 Claude Code / Python / GitHub 搭建自动化汇报（如 Google Ads 自动汇报至 Lark 机器人结合 AI 分析数据），具备技术自驱动力。
技术协同：以“产品经理 + 设计师”的双重视角与开发团队高效对接，甚至通过 VS Code 参与前端页面实现，降低沟通损耗，输出可视化简洁明了的 UI/UX 设计。
